<form action="/search" method="get" class="search-form" style="background-color: black; padding: 15px; border-radius: 12px; max-width: 400px; margin: auto; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px;">
  <!-- Search Input -->
  <input 
    type="text" 
    name="q" 
    placeholder="Search products..." 
    class="search-input" 
    style="
      flex: 1 1 calc(100% - 20px); /* Full width */
      padding: 12px; 
      border: none; 
      border-radius: 8px; 
      color: #39ff14; 
      background-color: #121212; 
      font-size: 16px;
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 8px rgba(57, 255, 20, 0.6);
    "
  />

  <!-- Collection Dropdown -->
  <select 
    name="collection" 
    class="collection-select" 
    style="
      flex: 1 1 calc(100% - 20px); /* Full width */
      padding: 12px; 
      border: none; 
      border-radius: 8px; 
      color: #39ff14; 
      background-color: #121212; 
      font-size: 16px;
      box-shadow: 0px 4px 6px rgba(57, 255, 20, 0.6);
      transition: box-shadow 0.2s ease; "
    onfocus="this.style.boxShadow='0px 6px 10px rgba(57, 255, 20, 0.8)';" 
    onblur="this.style.boxShadow='0px 4px 6px rgba(57, 255, 20, 0.6)';"
  >
    <option value="">All Collections</option>
    {% for collection in collections %}
      <option value="{{ collection.handle }}">{{ collection.title }}</option>
    {% endfor %}
  </select>

  <!-- Search Button -->
  <button 
    type="submit" 
    class="search-button" 
    style="
      flex: 1 1 100%; /* Full width button */
      padding: 12px; 
      background: linear-gradient(145deg, #2aff1a, #1ae600); 
      color: black; 
      font-size: 16px; 
      font-weight: bold; 
      border: none; 
      border-radius: 8px; 
      cursor: pointer; 
      box-shadow: 0px 5px 10px rgba(57, 255, 20, 0.7), 0px -3px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
      transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
    "
    onmouseover="this.style.transform='translateY(-2px)'; this.style.boxShadow='0px 7px 12px rgba(57, 255, 20, 0.9), 0px -4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4)';" 
    onmouseout="this.style.transform='translateY(0)'; this.style.boxShadow='0px 5px 10px rgba(57, 255, 20, 0.7), 0px -3px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)';"
  >
    Search
  </button>
</form>

<script>
  // Attach event listener to dynamically set collection in the query string
  document.querySelector('.search-form').addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
    const collectionSelect = document.querySelector('.collection-select');
    const selectedCollection = collectionSelect.value;
    
    if (selectedCollection) {
      // Modify action URL to include selected collection
      this.action = `/collections/${selectedCollection}/search`;
    }
  });
</script>
